data.name: Michael
data.gender_notes: Michael is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A rhetorical Hebrew name: mi, 'who', + ka, 'like', + El, 'God' — 'Who is like God?'. Its root is Hebrew m-y-k-ʾ-l. The archangel Michael (Daniel 10:13; Revelation 12:7). Michael is a Hebrew name meaning “Who is like God?”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Michael expresses “Who is like God?”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: A rhetorical Hebrew name: mi, 'who', + ka, 'like', + El, 'God' — 'Who is like God?'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Michael total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
